verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page documents its own Google and Outlook calendar integration for on-call schedules, and says schedules can be kept in a shared Google calendar. It is not documented whether this publishes an individual's shifts to a personal calendar via a subscribable feed, or mainly imports or manages schedules from a shared calendar. Missing for 10: explicit per-user calendar feed (iCal/webcal URL) of personal shifts, documentation of sync direction and update behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, my shifts sync to my personal calendar via a feed so I always know when I'm on the hook

citations.quote: Manage on-call schedules from our built-in web interface or keep them in a shared Google calendar.
Leverage one of our standard rotation schedules to instantly pre-fill your on-call calendar.
